stories.text: St Mary Magdalene's stands on the site of a Saxon church.[^s1] Its tower was built in stages between the 12th and 14th centuries, and its porch in 1320.[^s1] Most of the Lords Byron lie in the family vault here, among them the poet Lord Byron, and his daughter Ada, Countess of Lovelace, rests there too.[^s1][^s2] Byron died in Greece on 19 April 1824; Westminster Abbey refused to bury him, and after he lay in state in London he was brought here.[^s2] The church is listed Grade II*.[^s1]

164991.sum: St Mary Magdalene’s church in Hucknall, Nottinghamshire, is a parish church in the Church of England dedicated to Jesus' companion Mary Magdalene. The church is Grade II* listed as it is a particularly significant building of more than local interest.
